prompt: When is the `GITHUB_TOKEN` created, and when does it stop working?
explanation: The token’s lifecycle is the job: generated before your steps run, scoped to that repository, and invalidated when the job finishes. That ephemerality is exactly why it beats a personal access token for in-workflow git and API work.

options.text: It is minted fresh for each job and revoked when the job ends
It is a permanent repository credential rotated yearly
It exists from repository creation until deleted by an admin
It is issued per workflow file and shared across its jobs
